sections.title: Two objects: to whom, and what
sections.content: ad ("to give") is a regular verb — you already used its command form, Add hozzá! ("Add it!"), back when you were cooking. Now meet the full verb: adok, adsz, ad, adunk, adtok, adnak. Like ajánl and keres, ad takes two things: the person receiving, in the -nak/-nek dative, and the thing given, in the accusative -t. A recepciós ad nekem egy kulcsot means "The receptionist gives me a key."

items.spanish: A recepciós ad egy kulcsot a vendégnek.
items.english: The receptionist gives a key to the guest.

sections.content: The person usually goes right before the thing given: ad NEKEM egy kulcsot, not egy kulcsot ad nekem — though both are grammatical, the first order is what you'll hear at a hotel desk.
